continuousIntegration.baseStageWorkScope: Counters are for this feature run. The 14236 generated regional base/single responses are new work for this source version; earlier zero-generation cache-hit results belong to their original pinned run.

base.scope: Every master chart/difficulty in both pinned published regional catalogues is accounted for; every natural LUCK chart has the complete native base/single source-level catalogue and four verified program archives. All team combinations and arbitrary play profiles are not pre-enumerated.

family.scope: All declared TW/JP chart and difficulty records; 1,250 actual minimum configurations per natural LUCK chart in one fixed non-minimum family. Native codec repacking uses zero DP. Not all owned teams or all play profiles.

proofScope.conditionalProgramsCoverage: Each grid conditional program has positive weight in one of 88 independently compared mixtures per chart; this does not claim an independent original DP for each of 15,625 grid jobs.
proofScope.dictionaryCompleteness: Catalogue coverage is complete for the declared tables. Dictionary indexes remain open and complete:false because they contain no global combination alias index.
proofScope.memoryCounterMeaning: maximumFamilyCacheBytesPerShard is the maximum reported retained-family allocation within a shard, not peak process RSS; retained-family bytes are not added across shards.
proofScope.speedComparison: The saved curves in 8 alias pairs per chart have identical joint endpoints; 18 original DPs per chart were independently uncached.
proofScope.u24Comparison: All independent reference endpoints are enclosed. Joint endpoints are not identical.
proofScope.workflowStatus: Successful artifact audits do not establish the conclusion of the enclosing workflow.

independentArtifactAudit.scope: Independent downloaded-artifact, source, receipt, complete-mapping and saved-curve audit. No native propagation was rerun by this audit.

continuousIntegration.inputScope: CI TW catalogue anchors have different request/snapshot hashes from the original PR40 newcomer inputs. JP hashes match. Local and CI generators are different builds of the same bound source.

crossContext.scope: Persisted full native identities from three contexts; this audit performs no new semantic equivalence inference.

packing.indexNormalization: Keep fingerprint/source/status and archive path/hash/bytes/mode/verifiedEntries; omit diagnostic timing/decoded-memory fields. Source indexes retained and measured separately.
